name: Grilled stingray
summary: Cá đuối nướng is grilled stingray, a seafood-pub plate eaten hot with herbs and rice paper.
howToEat: Eat it hot, with herbs, rolled in rice paper.
In Dong Hoi the stingray is rinsed, seasoned, and grilled on foil or a banana leaf.
where: In Da Nang, on Phan Tứ in Ngũ Hành Sơn, in the evening, from about 17:00 to midnight. It shares the street with frog in lemongrass and chili and a seafood hotpot.
In Dong Hoi, at restaurants by cửa Nhật Lệ.
seoDescription: Cá đuối nướng is grilled stingray, eaten hot with herbs and rice paper. Where to eat it in Da Nang and Dong Hoi.
